WebUI to get:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Unified access to 1600+ LLMs</strong> through a single API</li>
<li><strong>Real-time cost tracking</strong> and per-user attribution</li>
<li><strong>Enterprise governance</strong> with budget limits and access controls</li>
<li><strong>Reliability features</strong> like fallbacks, caching, and retries</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="option-b-portkey-manifold-pipe-enterprise"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#option-b-portkey-manifold-pipe-enterprise" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="gray" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 576 512"><path d="M0 256C0 167.6 71.6 96 160 96h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C98.1 144 48 194.1 48 256s50.1 112 112 112h72c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H160C71.6 416 0 344.4 0 256zm576 0c0 88.4-71.6 160-160 160H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c61.9 0 112-50.1 112-112s-50.1-112-112-112H344c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24h72c88.4 0 160 71.6 160 160zM184 232H392c13.3 0 24 10.7 24 24s-10.7 24-24 24H184c-13.3 0-24-10.7-24-24s10.7-24 24-24z"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Option B: Portkey Manifold Pipe (Enterprise)</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">The Manifold Pipe solves a critical enterprise problem: <strong>per-user attribution with shared API keys</strong>.</span>
<span data-as="p">In typical deployments, a shared API key means all requests appear anonymous in logs. The Manifold Pipe automatically forwards Open WebUI user context (email, name, role) to Portkey, enabling true per-user cost tracking and governance.</span>

When enabled, any version fields omitted from the request are backfilled from the current latest version, allowing you to update only the fields you need. When `patch` is omitted or `false`, all version fields must be provided together (original strict validation).\\n\\n**Metadata-only updates:** Fields like `name`, `collection_id`, `version_description`, and `virtual_key` can always be updated independently without affecting versioning.\\n\",\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/update-prompt\"},{\"title\":\"Delete Prompt\",\"openapi\":\"delete /prompts/{promptId}\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/delete-prompt\"},{\"title\":\"Publish Prompt\",\"openapi\":\"put /prompts/{promptId}/makeDefault\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/publish-prompt\"},{\"title\":\"List Prompt Versions\",\"openapi\":\"get /prompts/{promptId}/versions\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/list-prompt-versions\"},{\"title\":\"Retrieve Prompt Version\",\"openapi\":\"get /prompts/{promptId}/versions/{versionId}\",\"description\":null,\"href\":\"/api-reference/admin-api/control-plane/prompts/retrieve-prompt-version\"},{\"title\":\"Update Prompt Version\",\"openapi\":\"put /prompts/{promptId}/versions/{versionId}\",\"description\":\"Updates metadata for a specific prompt version. **This endpoint only supports updating the `label_id` field.**\\n\\nPrompt versions are immutable — their `string`, `parameters`, and `model` content cannot be changed after creation.
